text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text: Ooh! So Ines finally made her debut too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 'cause I'm aiming for the Derby too!

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even I know about that one~. It's 
like, some crazy big race, right?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
I mean, doesn't it still feel unreal~? 
Tracen Academy is where all those stars on 
TV graduated from, right~?

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Totally! The idea of Ines being at a 
super-elite school is just totally wild! 
It's crazy, seriously!!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Now, now~. Ines is taking a break, but as 
for you two girls over there~, how many 
minutes does it take to take out the 
trash~?

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa. Crap, it's the manager! ...Hey, 
Ines!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? Whaaat is it~?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
We're rootin' for ya~. Not really sure 
what's going on, but do your best~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Ahaha, yeah. I received your cheer 
loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Saturday. On this day, I had arranged a 
mock race with a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: One... two! Phew! One... two!!
choice_data_list: Um... sorry to keep you waiting.
Um... sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh. No, no! Not at all, I didn't wait! If 
anything, I'm sorry for getting here 
before the meeting time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I love moving my body. Warm-ups included.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl with the dazzling white smile, 
Mejiro Ryan, is Ines Fujin's roommate and 
classmate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Ines has a part-time job, right? 
I saw her jump out of bed early this 
morning and head out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Working right up until practice time. Just 
to help out my family, even a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Watching her dedication by her side, I 
often think... just what an incredible 
core of strength she has."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Compared to that, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I will bring that Shield back to Mejiro. 
With these very hands...! I swear I 
will...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! McQueen-san, you look so gallant 
and wonderful again today~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I am still far too green in so many 
ways! I intend to learn as much as I 
possibly can today as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As a member of the Mejiro family, big 
things are expected of me in the Classics! 
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, she is the hope of that 
prestigious family. Even securing this 
mock race with her is quite a lucky break 
in itself.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, likewise! As long as time permits, 
I'll give it every ounce of muscle I've 
got!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting~!! It's right on 
1:00 PM—barely made it, but I have 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines! Good work on your shift! 
Everything's ready on our end!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Ryan-chan! I'll do a quick warm-up 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the mock race between the two 
began—

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: Good work, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines, that's amazing!! Your stamina is on 
a whole other level compared to before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, your positioning through the middle 
of the race was flawless. You've grown so 
much, it's like you're a completely 
different person from six months ago...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, Ryan-chan caught me at the 
very end. Aww, bummer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez, next time I'm totally gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Even I—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm not giving up the Derby either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heh... The Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I saw it on the TV at my 
part-time job. They said Ryan-chan is 
going for the Classic Triple Crown too."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That the entire Mejiro family is rooting 
for me. And that as their promising new 
star, they expect me to conquer the Derby, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin looks straight at her roommate 
and continues speaking.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But you know. Even against someone as 
amazing as Ryan-chan, I definitely don't 
want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Ines. You're already looking that far 
ahead, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, it's not that far off. I mean, we 
have less than a year left.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I have to get way stronger before then, 
right? Because right now, I'm nowhere near 
Ryan-chan and the others."
choice_data_list:
That's why you're running in the Asahi Hai 
FS, right?

That's why you're running in the Asahi Hai 
FS, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's to make up for my lack of 
experience, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha, haha. To enter a GⅠ with that kind 
of condition... that's some serious 
determination..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because we don't have much time. If 
we don't give it everything we've got, 
it'll be over in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines. Actually, I'm planning to go watch 
the Asahi Hai FS next time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Really?! In that case, I'll give it even 
more of my all during the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...Yeah, do your best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You're amazing. Never scared, 
charging straight ahead no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what I'll think when I see you 
race...
